messages:
luis-m: Hey all — first week settlin' in! Couple of setup hiccups: plugged my MacBook into the office dock and battery shows 'Not charging' stuck at 1%. USB ports on the dock drop my mechanical keyboard intermittently. Also can't join redwood-corp WiFi: macOS errors with 'certificate validation failed'. Monitor that shipped only has a DisplayPort cable but the dock is USB-C. Who's best to ping for swaps/how-tos? :grimacing:

ava-it: Welcome onboard @luis-m :wave: Sorry about the rough start. Can you grab the dock serial from the sticker underside and run two quick commands? 1) `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` (paste the relevant section) 2) `pmset -g batt`. If you can, snap a photo of the dock label and attach. I'll open a hardware ticket if it looks like a dock/cable fault.

luis-m: Dock SN DCK-78A2F3. system_profiler snippet:

USB:
  USB 3.1 Bus:
    Dock Inc. Dock Adapter:
      Product ID: 0x0a12
      Vendor ID: 0x1a2b
      Version: 1.00
      Speed: Up to 5 Gb/s

pmset output:
Battery (Internal):
  Charge: 1%; Discharging

Quick dmesg tail when I replug USB-C:
usb 3-2: USB disconnect, device number 5
usb 3-2: new full-speed USB device number 6 using xhci_hcd
usb 3-2: can't set config #1, error -71

ava-it: Thanks — that error -71 + can't set config is usually a firmware/hardware handshake issue (often cable or dock). I'll create ticket TKT-9123 for a hardware swap and new USB-C cable. For the WiFi cert issue: we rotated the corp root cert yesterday. If your machine image pre-dates that rotation, macOS will reject the AP cert. Try: connect to wired network or VPN, then install the profile from https://redwood.internal/it/kb/wifi-eap. If you can't access that URL, reply and I'll attach the profile here.

sam-se: Adding network context — yep we did the cert rotation and some non-enrolled Macs need a manual profile install. If wired/VPN isn't possible, we can temporarily enable your MAC address to allow a hotspot join and push an MDM-trigger to enroll, but wired/VPN is preferred.

mike-facilities: @ava-it I scheduled a courier pickup for the defective dock tomorrow 10:00-12:00. Replacement will ship same day. I'll DM the pickup label and the FedEx tracking once it's scanned. @luis-m does 10-12 work for pickup?

luis-m: 10-12 is perfect, thanks! About the monitor: I have a DP->USB-C passive adapter. Is it safe to use or should I wait for a vendor cable?

ava-it: Passive DP->USB-C adapters vary. If your monitor supports DP Alt Mode over USB-C it'll probably work, but we've seen flaky behavior. We'll bundle a tested USB-C cable with the replacement dock so you get a matched pair.

kit-bot: [hardware-swap] Created TKT-9123 assigned to ava-it. Status: hardware_swap_scheduled -> pickup_confirmed.

mike-facilities: Pickup label DM'ed to @luis-m. Replacement tracking: https://trackingsvc.example/fedex/ZX123456789 (ETA tomorrow ~15:00 local).

luis-m: Great — I'll try the VPN+profile install tonight and report back. Appreciate the quick help everyone :thumbsup:
